description: Human hematopoiesis differentiation map for the cbc-multiome MultiAssayExperiment. Two layers: (a) data-backed subgraph over the 12 sampled cell types, (b) canonical reference nodes/edges (no omics). Branch geometry reflects the modern continuum/CLOUD-HSPC view, NOT a strict discrete tree. Literature-grounded (deep-research 2026-06-04); see hematopoiesis_map.md for narrative + verification votes.

modeling_notes.topology: continuum-with-canalization, not a discrete tree. Early progenitor nodes (hsc/mpp/clp/cmp/gmp) form a broad blurry basin; mature lineages are canalized endpoints.
modeling_notes.elevation_guidance: Waddington 'elevation' = a continuous potential. Defensible options: distance-from-HSC along the graph, an accessibility-derived potential (Buenrostro basin), or 1 - differentiation-potential. For the data-driven terrain, per-edge magnitude = count of distal cCREs that flip methylation/accessibility between adjacent nodes.
modeling_notes.layer_independence: methylation and chromatin-accessibility are TEMPORALLY DECOUPLED (Barnett 2020); render as separate toggleable surfaces, not one fused rail.
modeling_notes.genome_locus: lineage decisions are written predominantly at DISTAL enhancers/cCREs, not promoters (Corces 2016). Distal cCRE accessibility is the most discriminative feature.

nodes.label: HSC
nodes.role: apex; broad low-primed basin; Er/Mk priming already present

nodes.label: MPP
nodes.role: multipotent; lineage bias measurable but not committed

nodes.label: CLP
nodes.role: lymphoid-primed; approximates Farlik MLP (MLP0 = multipotent apex); methylation-shielded from default myeloid program
nodes.approximation: MLP≈CLP (MLP0 CD7-CD10- is the distinctively-methylated multipotent apex)

nodes.label: CMP
nodes.role: gateable population emerging from continuum; myeloerythroid priming
nodes.caveat: not a discrete fundamental entity; emerges from the continuum (Velten 2017)

nodes.label: GMP
nodes.caveat: gateable but continuum-derived; internally fate-primed subpopulations (Paul 2015)

nodes.label: B cell
nodes.role: canalized endpoint; enhancer repertoire reshaped largely independent of early priming (Bevington 2015)

nodes.label: Monocyte
nodes.role: canalized endpoint; ATAC waves precede demethylation (Barnett 2020)

nodes.label: Neutrophil
nodes.role: canalized endpoint; no ATAC (granulocytes absent from PBMC/CD34 ATAC atlases)

nodes.label: Eosinophil
nodes.role: canalized endpoint; sparsest node (no ATAC/DNase/methylation); GMP attachment is an open question

nodes.label: LMPP
nodes.role: canonical reference; lymphoid-primed multipotent (in Corces 13-pop panel)

nodes.label: MEP
nodes.role: canonical reference; at single-cell resolution principally unipotent erythroid, NOT a true Mk/Er bipotent progenitor (Notta 2016)

nodes.label: MLP
nodes.role: canonical reference; multilymphoid progenitor ≈ CLP (data mapped to clp node)

nodes.label: Erythroid
nodes.role: canonical reference; branches directly off HSC/MPP

nodes.label: Megakaryocyte/Platelet
nodes.role: canonical reference; branches directly off HSC (Mk-primed HSC)

edges.epigenetic_signature: earliest transition within the CLOUD basin; minimal commitment
lymphoid priming (MESP/ID motifs); methylation MAINTAINED to shield from default myeloid program
myeloerythroid priming (GATA motifs); onset of demethylation at GATA1/TAL1 distal sites
rapid enhancer accessibility waves; demethylation lags (decoupled)

edges.note: exact attachment (GMP vs dedicated eosinophil progenitor) is an open question

edges.epigenetic_signature: T-lineage program (maturation is thymic/extramedullary; not captured between these two nodes)
edges.note: edge spans an extramedullary maturation gap
edge spans an extramedullary maturation gap

edges.epigenetic_signature: erythroid (GATA1) program; branches high off HSC/MPP, NOT via CMP→MEP
Mk-primed HSC (CD41/CD61+); shortcut directly from HSC

edges.note: classical tree edge; modern view branches Er/Mk off HSC/MPP directly
sorted MEPs are principally unipotent erythroid, not Mk/Er bipotent

Velten2017.ref: Velten et al. 2017, Nat Cell Biol

Notta2016.note: two-tier adult collapse; Er/Mk off HSC

Corces2016.note: distal cCREs classify cell types (91% vs 78%); 13-pop reference chromatin map; enhancer priming

Farlik2016.ref: Farlik et al. 2016, Cell Stem Cell
Farlik2016.note: WGBS hierarchy; lineage-asymmetric demethylation at GATA1/TAL1; MLP0 apex; THIS IS OUR PROGENITOR METHYLATION SOURCE

Lara-Astiaso2014.note: de novo lineage enhancer establishment foreshadows expression

Paul2015.note: myeloid progenitors are fate-primed subpopulations, not bulk

refuted_do_not_assert: Lineage-restricted cells emerge from the continuum WITHOUT ANY transit through intermediates (killed 0-3).
~70% of HSC->progenitor expression change is lineage-independent (killed 0-3).
No progenitor occupies a mixed/co-primed state (killed 0-3) — co-primed states DO exist.
LMPP/MLP keep lymphoid and myeloid potential coupled (killed 1-2).
